lessonTitle: 55. Why there are only five regular polyhedra
lessonTitleEnglish: Why there are only five regular polyhedra
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: At least 3 faces meet at a vertex of a regular polyhedron and their angles add up to less than 360°; with triangles (60°) that allows 3, 4 or 5 faces.
stages.headlineEnglish: At least 3 faces meet at a vertex of a regular polyhedron and their angles add up to less than 360°; with triangles (60°) that allows 3, 4 or 5 faces.

stages.headline: Squares (90°) allow only k = 3, pentagons (108°) only k = 3, and hexagons already give 3 · 120° = 360°.
stages.headlineEnglish: Squares (90°) allow only k = 3, pentagons (108°) only k = 3, and hexagons already give 3 · 120° = 360°.

stages.headline: So there are exactly five kinds of regular polyhedra.
stages.headlineEnglish: So there are exactly five kinds of regular polyhedra.

stages.headline: Why is there no regular polyhedron with hexagonal faces?
